summary: Baytex Energy Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing the TSX's acceptance of its renewed normal course issuer bid (NCIB). The company may repurchase up to 70,899,359 common shares (10% of public float) over 12 months starting July 2, 2026. Purchases will occur on the open market via TSX, NYSE, and alternative platforms at prevailing market prices. BMO Nesbitt Burns acts as designated broker, with an automatic share purchase plan (Rule 10b5-1) for blackout periods. This capital-return program is a standard buyback, not tied to a special corporate event. Monitoring: pace of repurchases and impact on per-share metrics.
